name: Default
shortDescription: Map tile server that serves vector and raster tiles from MBTiles and PMTiles files with MapLibre GL styles, plus WMTS and a browser preview.

alerts.message: On first start the server downloads a small Zurich sample. To serve your own maps, copy .mbtiles or .pmtiles files into the data volume and either delete the sample or add a config.json listing your files, then restart. Without a config.json only the first tile file found is served.
TileServer GL has no login: every map, style and tile it serves is publicly reachable.
